name: Alameda County Workforce Development Board
description: Free career services, job training, and employment support in Alameda County
fullDescription: The Alameda County Workforce Development Board funds free career centers that provide job search help, training, and employment support for job seekers in Alameda County outside the city of Oakland.
whatTheyOffer:
- Workshops on job searching, resumes, interviewing, and networking
- Case management and career coaching for enrolled job seekers
- Individual Training Accounts to pay for occupational training
- On-the-job training (earn while you learn with an employer)
- Free online training and certificates through Metrix (SkillUp Alameda)
- Connection to job fairs and employers
- Services for re-entry job seekers, English language learners, refugees, and youth
howToGetIt:
1. Contact the nearest career center
2. Eden Area AJCC (Hayward): 510-670-5700
3. Tri-Cities Career Center (Newark): 510-742-2323
4. Tri-Valley Career Center (Pleasanton): 925-416-5100
5. Complete registration and eligibility for WIOA services
6. Oakland residents can also use Oakland's own workforce system
